sentences.en: The only useful answers are those that raise new questions.
sentences.zh: 只有能提出新问题的回答才是有用的。

sentences.en: If I gave no answer, I would not have spoken.
sentences.zh: 如果我不回答，也就不会开口说话了。

sentences.en: It doesn't matter whether your answer is right or wrong.
sentences.zh: 无论你的答案对还是错都无关紧要。

senses.zh: 答复；解答；答辩适应，符合，满足回应，响应
